summary: To see the exact args Ansible passed to a Windows module, run with ANSIBLE_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES=1, log on as the same user, open the ansible-tmp folder under %TEMP%\.., and read module_args from $json_raw in the script.
questions: How do I see the arguments Ansible sent to my Windows module?
Where does Ansible leave temp files on a Windows host?

answer_card.title: Capture module args on Windows
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Run Ansible with `ANSIBLE_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES=1`.
2. Log on as the same user Ansible used.
3. Go to `%TEMP%\..` and open the `ansible-tmp-*` folder.
4. Open the module's PowerShell script; `$json_raw` contains `module_args`. Copy them into `$complex_args` or `args.json`.
